title: Regression Adjustment for Ratios of Treatment Effects in Randomized Experiments
abstract: arXiv:2610.35666v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study regression adjustment for ratios of treatment effects in completely randomized experiments. The existing literature adjusts the numerator and denominator separately, but this approach misses the efficiency target, loss of which matters more when richer or high-dimensional covariate information and flexible or regularized prediction methods are used to pursue further efficiency gains. We propose a two-step estimator that directly predicts the relevant transformed outcome. Using cross-fitting, our method accommodates high-dimensional first-stage prediction while keeping the final adjustment fixed-dimensional, thereby avoiding instability from a growing number of adjustment covariates. We further develop persistence-based LASSO theory that does not require sparsity, permits more covariates than observations, and allows cross-validated penalty selection under prediction-level conditions. translated_title: 随机实验中处理效应比率的回归调整
translated_abstract: 我们研究了完全随机实验中处理效应比率的回归调整方法。现有文献分别对分子和分母进行调整，但这种方法未能达到效率目标；当使用更丰富或高维的协变量信息以及灵活的或正则化的预测方法来追求进一步的效率提升时，这种效率损失的影响更为显著。我们提出了一个两步估计量，直接预测相关的变换结果。通过使用交叉拟合，我们的方法能够在第一阶段容纳高维预测，同时保持最终调整为固定维度，从而避免了调整协变量数量不断增加所带来的不稳定性。我们进一步发展了基于持久性的LASSO理论，该理论不要求稀疏性假设，允许协变量数量多于观测值数量，并在预测层面的条件下允许通过交叉验证来选择惩罚参数。为了获得额外的效率提升，我们的增广……
tldr: 提出了一种两步交叉拟合估计量，通过直接预测变换结果来改进随机实验中处理效应比率的回归调整，克服了传统分子分母分别调整方法的效率损失问题，并发展了无需稀疏性假设、可处理高维协变量的持久性LASSO理论。
en_tdlr: Proposes a two-step cross-fitted estimator that directly predicts transformed outcomes to improve regression adjustment for ratios of treatment effects in randomized experiments, overcoming efficiency losses of separate numerator-denominator adjustment, and develops persistence-based LASSO theory that requires no sparsity assumptions and handles high-dimensional covariates.
